summary.text:
This resolution supports the designation of National FFA (Future Farmers of America) Week.
It also celebrates the 50th anniversary of the chartering of Alaska as a State FFA Association of the National FFA Organization.

title: Expressing support for the designation of February 21 through February 28, 2026, as "National FFA Week", recognizing the important role of the National Future Farmers of America (FFA) Organization in developing the next generation of globally conscious leaders who will change the world, and celebrating the 50th anniversary of the chartering of the State of Alaska as a State FFA Association.
